extraction_notes: The document is labeled 'ערוץ עכשיו 14' (Channel Now 14) as commissioner. Pollster is 'חברת Next Data'. The main question table on page 2 shows results with both weighted percentages (אחוז גולמי) and seats (מנדטים). Below-threshold parties totaling 3.25% are listed separately and aggregated into other_pct. Response rate is 14.7% (2,200 respondents out of 14,970 initial sample). Margin of error ±2.1% at 95% confidence. The remaining pages contain non-vote-intention questions (PM suitability, bloc preferences, issue questions) which were not extracted per spec.
